infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Zimi Live uses your camera when you take a chat or profile photo, start a video call, or host a live broadcast.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Zimi Live uses your microphone when you record a voice message, start or join an audio or video call, or host a live broadcast.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Zimi Live lets you choose photos from your library to send in chats or add to your profile.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Zimi Live saves a chat photo to your library when you tap Download.
